annotations.title: Calculate Korea comprehensive real estate tax

description: Korean comprehensive real estate holding tax on housing (종합부동산세 주택분) for 2026: deduction 1.2B KRW for a one-house household (900M otherwise, 0 for corporations), fair market ratio 60%, rates 0.5-2.7% (3+ houses: 2-5% above a 1.2B base; corporations 2.7%/5%), property-tax overlap credit, one-house age (20/30/40%) and holding (20/40/50%) credits up to 80%, rural special tax 20%. Excludes the 150% year-on-year cap.
